itineraries.name: Icons of the Danube: Christmas Markets
itineraries.route: Budapest · Bratislava · Vienna · Dürnstein · Linz · Passau · Vilshofen
itineraries.blurb: A Christmas markets cruise on AmaMagna from Budapest to Vilshofen, with a choice of tours at each stop.
itineraries.overview: This AmaMagna sailing runs along the Danube from Budapest to Vilshofen, stopping in Bratislava, Vienna, the Wachau Valley, Linz and Passau. Most days offer a choice of guided tours, with Christmas market visits in Budapest, Bratislava, Vienna, Linz, Salzburg and Passau.
highlights: Schönbrunn Palace and Rathaus Christmas markets in Vienna
Melk Abbey and a wine tasting in the Wachau Valley
Full-day choice of Salzburg or Český Krumlov

days.title: Budapest: boarding
days.summary: Board AmaMagna in Budapest. A welcome dinner is held in the evening.

days.title: Budapest: Christmas market and Danube Bend
days.summary: A city tour covers Buda, Pest, the Great Market Hall and a Christmas market, or you can hike Castle Hill. The ship later cruises the Danube Bend.
excursions: Buda city tour and Christmas Markets

days.title: Bratislava: Old Town and Christmas market
days.summary: Old Town walking tour with a Christmas market visit. Other choices are a local food tour or a hike up to Bratislava Castle.

days.title: Vienna: Christmas markets and Schönbrunn
days.summary: Tour the former Imperial Palace and the Opera House with the Maria Theresa Platz market, or bike along the Danube. The Schönbrunn Palace market follows in the afternoon, and the Rathaus market at night.

days.title: Wachau Valley: Dürnstein and Melk
days.summary: From Krems, see Dürnstein on foot or by bike, or try its apricot specialties. Afternoon choices are Melk Abbey, a bike ride to Spitz or a hike, followed by an evening wine tasting.

days.title: Linz: Salzburg or Český Krumlov
days.summary: Spend the full day in Salzburg, with its Old Town, cathedral and Christmas markets, or in Český Krumlov with its castle. Back in Linz, take a short Old Town walking tour or a bike ride.
excursions: Full Day Salzburg Excursion and Christmas Market
UNESCO city walking tour and Christmas Market

days.title: Passau: Christmas markets
days.summary: Walking tour of Passau with its Christmas markets, or one of two hikes.
excursions: “City of Three Rivers” Walking Tour with Christmas Markets
Passau Castle Hike to Paulinerkloister Mariahilf

days.title: Vilshofen: disembark
days.summary: Leave the ship in Vilshofen.

itineraries.name: Christmas Markets on the Danube
itineraries.route: Budapest · Bratislava · Vienna · Weissenkirchen · Linz · Passau · Vilshofen
itineraries.blurb: A Danube Christmas markets cruise from Budapest to Vilshofen, with stops in Bratislava, Vienna, the Wachau Valley, Linz and Passau.
itineraries.overview: This sailing runs along the Danube from Budapest to Vilshofen through Hungary, Slovakia, Austria and Germany. Christmas market visits are offered in Budapest, Bratislava, Vienna, Linz, Salzburg, Český Krumlov and Passau, with city tours, tastings and bike rides as other choices.
highlights: Christmas markets at Schönbrunn and Rathaus Square in Vienna
Dürnstein and Melk Abbey in the Wachau Valley
Full-day choice of Salzburg or Český Krumlov

days.title: Budapest: boarding
days.summary: Board the ship on the Danube in Budapest.

days.title: Budapest: Buda and Pest
days.summary: Start in Buda's Castle District with Fisherman's Bastion and Matthias Church, then a Christmas market or a Castle Hill hike. The afternoon tour of Pest covers Parliament, Heroes' Square and the Shoes on the Danube Bank memorial.
excursions: Buda City Tour and Christmas Markets

days.title: Bratislava: Old Town and Christmas market
days.summary: Choose a walking tour with the Christmas market, a local food tour, or a hike up to Bratislava Castle.
excursions: Coronation City Walking Tour with Christmas Market Visit

days.title: Vienna: Christmas markets and Schönbrunn
days.summary: Tour the former Imperial Palace and the Opera House, ending in the city center, or take a guided bike ride. Christmas markets at Schönbrunn and Rathaus Square follow.
excursions: “Imperial Vienna” Tour with Maria Theresa Platz Christmas Market

days.title: Weissenkirchen: Dürnstein and Melk
days.summary: Walking tour of Dürnstein with a wine tasting, or apricot tastings in the village. Later, bike to Melk or sail the Wachau Valley to visit the Benedictine Abbey.
excursions: Dürnstein Walking Tour and Wine Tasting

days.title: Linz: Salzburg, Český Krumlov or Old Town
days.summary: Full-day trips go to the Christmas markets of Salzburg or Český Krumlov. In Linz, take an Old Town walk with the Mozart House and market, or a bike ride, with a distillery tour in the afternoon.
excursions: Full Day Salzburg Excursion with Christmas Markets
Full Day Český Krumlov Excursion with Christmas Markets
“UNESCO City of Media Arts” Walking Tour and Christmas Market

days.title: Passau and Vilshofen
days.summary: Walking tour of Passau with the St. Stephen's Square Christmas market, or a fitness hike. The ship then sails to Vilshofen.
excursions: “City of Three Rivers” Walking Tour and Christmas Markets

days.title: Vilshofen: disembark
days.summary: Leave the ship in Vilshofen.

itineraries.name: Christmas Markets on the Rhine
itineraries.route: Amsterdam · Cologne · Rüdesheim · Ludwigshafen · Strasbourg · Breisach · Basel
itineraries.blurb: A Rhine Christmas markets cruise from Amsterdam to Basel, with stops in Germany and France.
itineraries.overview: This sailing runs along the Rhine from Amsterdam to Basel, through the Netherlands, Germany, France and Switzerland. Christmas market tours are offered in Cologne, Düsseldorf, Rüdesheim, Heidelberg, Speyer, Strasbourg and Colmar.
highlights: Cologne Christmas market beside the Gothic cathedral
Scenic cruising through the Rhine Gorge
Choice of Heidelberg or Speyer

days.title: Amsterdam: boarding
days.summary: Arrive in Amsterdam and board the ship.

days.title: Amsterdam: canal cruise
days.summary: Canal cruise in Amsterdam, followed by scenic cruising out of the city.

days.title: Cologne and Düsseldorf: Christmas markets
days.summary: Choose a walking tour with Christmas markets in Cologne or Düsseldorf, or a guided bike tour in Düsseldorf. Cologne's market sits beside its Gothic cathedral.
excursions: Cologne Walking Tour and Christmas Markets
Düsseldorf Walking Tour and Christmas Markets

days.title: Rhine Gorge and Rüdesheim
days.summary: Scenic cruising past the castles and vineyards of the Rhine Gorge. Rüdesheim options include a wine tasting, a gondola ride, a vineyard hike and the Christmas market.

days.title: Ludwigshafen: Heidelberg or Speyer
days.summary: Visit Heidelberg, with its hilltop castle and Christmas market, or Speyer, with its cathedral and town square. A Philosopher's Path hike is also offered in Heidelberg.
excursions: Heidelberg Philosopher’s Path Hike and Christmas Markets

days.title: Strasbourg: city tour and Christmas markets
days.summary: City tour or bike tour of Strasbourg, or a walking tour and Christmas markets in Baden-Baden.
excursions: Strasbourg City Tour and Christmas Markets
Baden-Baden Walking Tour and Christmas Markets

days.title: Breisach: Colmar and Freiburg
days.summary: Visit Colmar and its Christmas market, or the medieval town of Freiburg and its market.

days.title: Basel: disembark
days.summary: Leave the ship in Basel.

itineraries.name: Iconic Christmas Markets
itineraries.route: Nuremberg · Regensburg · Passau · Melk · Vienna · Budapest
itineraries.blurb: A Christmas markets cruise from Nuremberg to Budapest, by way of Regensburg, Passau, Melk and Vienna.
itineraries.overview: This sailing runs from Nuremberg to Budapest by the Main-Danube Canal and the Danube, through Germany, Austria and Hungary. Christmas market visits are offered in Nuremberg, Regensburg, Passau, Salzburg, Vienna and Budapest.
highlights: Nuremberg's Christkindlesmarkt
Melk Abbey museum and library
Schönbrunn Palace Christmas market in Vienna

days.title: Nuremberg: boarding
days.summary: Arrive in Nuremberg and board the ship.

days.title: Nuremberg: Christkindlesmarkt
days.summary: A city tour covers World War II sites, the Imperial Castle and the city ramparts, or spend the morning at the Christkindlesmarkt. A food tour samples sausages, beer and lebkuchen, and the ship later uses the Main-Danube Canal to cross the Continental Divide.

days.title: Regensburg: Old Town and Christmas markets
days.summary: Walking tour with the Porta Praetoria and Old Town Hall, plus the Old Town Christmas market. Other options are a Bavarian food tour, a bike ride to Walhalla and the Thurn and Taxis Christmas market.
excursions: UNESCO City Tour and Christmas Market

days.title: Passau: Christmas market or Salzburg
days.summary: Walking tour of Passau with its Christmas market, a fitness hike, or a full-day trip to Salzburg's Old Town, cathedral and markets.
excursions: Full Day Salzburg Excursion with Christmas Markets
“City of Three Rivers” Walking Tour and Christmas Market

days.title: Melk: abbey
days.summary: Visit Melk Abbey with its museum and library, or take a bike ride around the town. A Rathaus Christmas market outing by night is also listed for this day.

days.title: Vienna: Christmas markets and Schönbrunn
days.summary: Tour the former Imperial Palace and the Opera House with Christmas markets, or take a Danube bike ride followed by the Schönbrunn Palace market.

days.title: Budapest: Buda and Pest
days.summary: Castle District tour with Fisherman's Bastion, Matthias Church and a Christmas market, or a hill hike. The afternoon tour of Pest covers Parliament, Heroes' Square and the Shoes on the Danube Bank memorial.
excursions: Buda City Tour and Christmas Markets

days.title: Budapest: disembark
days.summary: Leave the ship in Budapest.

itineraries.name: Danube Christmas Delights
itineraries.route: Budapest · Bratislava · Vienna · Krems · Linz · Passau
itineraries.blurb: An 8-day Danube cruise from Budapest to Passau, with Christmas markets and a sail through the Wachau Valley.
itineraries.overview: This cruise runs from Budapest to Passau, stopping in Bratislava, Vienna, Krems and Linz. It covers four countries, with Christmas markets in Vienna, Linz and Passau.
highlights: Vienna's Christmas markets
Göttweig Abbey from Krems
Sailing the UNESCO-listed Wachau Valley

days.title: Budapest: boarding
days.summary: Board the ship in Budapest. Christmas markets are open at Vörösmarty Square, St. Stephen's Basilica and Fő Square in Buda.

days.title: Budapest: Castle District
days.summary: See the Castle District, with Matthias Church, Fisherman's Bastion and Buda Castle, which was home to Hungary's kings for almost 700 years.
excursions: The Royal Palace & Gardens of Gödöllö

days.title: Bratislava: Old Town and Christmas markets
days.summary: Visit the Old Town markets below Bratislava Castle. Stalls in Hlavné Námestie sell local crafts, and a decorated Christmas tram runs between the fairs.

days.title: Vienna: Christmas markets
days.summary: Vienna holds markets at Schönbrunn Palace, Freyung, Am Hof and Belvedere, with crafts, music and choirs.
excursions: Behind the Scenes at the Lipizzaner Stallions

days.title: Krems and the Wachau Valley
days.summary: Krems is a university town known for Riesling and Veltliner wines. The ship also sails the Wachau Valley, a UNESCO site.
excursions: Göttweig Abbey with Apricot Dumpling Demonstration

days.title: Linz: Christmas markets
days.summary: Visit the market on the main square and the nativity scene at the Volksgarten in the capital of Upper Austria, home of the Linzer Torte.

days.title: Passau: Christkindlmarkt
days.summary: The market surrounds St. Stephen's Cathedral, which has Europe's largest pipe organ and hosts Christmas concerts during the season.

days.title: Passau: departure
days.summary: Leave the ship and travel home, or continue on a post-cruise extension.

itineraries.name: Christmas on the Rhine
itineraries.route: Amsterdam · Dordrecht · Cologne · Koblenz · Rüdesheim · Mannheim · Speyer · Strasbourg · Breisach · Basel
itineraries.blurb: An 8-day Rhine cruise from Amsterdam to Basel, with Christmas markets in Germany and France.
itineraries.overview: This cruise runs from Amsterdam to Basel through the Netherlands, Germany, France and Switzerland. Stops include Cologne, Koblenz, Rüdesheim, Speyer and Strasbourg, and the ship sails the UNESCO-listed Middle Rhine.
highlights: Cologne's holiday markets
Sailing the Middle Rhine past Lorelei Rock
The Drosselgasse in Rüdesheim

days.title: Amsterdam: boarding
days.summary: Board the ship in Amsterdam, a city of about 90 islands linked by 1,500 bridges, and home to the Rijksmuseum.

days.title: Dordrecht and the Dutch waterways
days.summary: Sail the Waal and Merwede through farmland and past windmills to Dordrecht, the oldest city in Holland.

days.title: Cologne: Christmas markets
days.summary: Themed markets run across the city during the season, including one beside Cologne Cathedral and a tented market at the harbor.

days.title: Koblenz and the Middle Rhine
days.summary: Visit the Koblenz market around the Schängel fountain, then sail the Middle Rhine to Rüdesheim and its Christmas Market of Nations.
excursions: Wine Tasting & Dinner at Eberbach Monastery
Wine Tasting & Dinner at Schloss Johannisberg Estate

days.title: Mannheim and Speyer: Christmas markets
days.summary: Mannheim's market has more than 160 booths around the water tower. Later, take a walking tour of Speyer and its Christmas market.

days.title: Strasbourg: Christkindelsmärik
days.summary: Strasbourg's market in the cathedral square dates to 1570, making it the oldest in France. Stalls sell Alsatian food and mulled wine.
excursions: Medieval Castle of Haut Koenigsbourg at Christmas Time
Strasbourg’s Historic Wine Cellar & Christmas Market

days.title: Breisach and the Black Forest area
days.summary: The Weihnachtsmarkt sits in the old town near St. Stephen's Cathedral. The included tour visits the Christmas markets of Freiburg, with an organ concert.
excursions: The Colmar Pocket in World War II: Museum & Memorial

days.title: Basel: departure
days.summary: Leave the ship and travel home, or continue on a post-cruise extension.

itineraries.name: Christmas on the Rhine & Main
itineraries.route: Nuremberg · Bamberg · Würzburg · Marktheidenfeld · Frankfurt · Baden-Baden · Strasbourg · Breisach · Basel
itineraries.blurb: An 11-day cruise from Nuremberg to Basel on the Main and Rhine, with a Christmas market at most stops.
itineraries.overview: This cruise runs from Nuremberg to Basel through Germany, France and Switzerland. Stops include Bamberg, Würzburg, Frankfurt, Baden-Baden and Strasbourg, with two days in Nuremberg and two in Basel.
highlights: Nuremberg's Christkindlesmarkt
Nativity scene in Bamberg's Maximiliansplatz
Sailing the Main River through the Spessart

days.title: Nuremberg: boarding
days.summary: Board the ship in Nuremberg, home to one of the world's oldest Christmas markets, known for lebkuchen and Nuremberg bratwurst.

days.title: Nuremberg: Old Town
days.summary: See the walled Old Town and the Imperial Castle, once a seat of power for German kings, then visit the Christkindlesmarkt.

days.title: Bamberg: Advent market
days.summary: The market fills Maximiliansplatz, with a large Franconian nativity scene. Artisans show their crafts at Elisabeth Church.

days.title: Würzburg: Residenz and Advent market
days.summary: Tour the Bishops' Residenz, then visit the Advent market beside the Falkenhaus and Marienkapelle, with local food and working artisans.

days.title: Marktheidenfeld and the Main River
days.summary: Visit the Marktplatz market, set among half-timbered homes near a medieval bridge over the Main, and see nearby Lohr am Main.

days.title: Frankfurt: Christmas market
days.summary: One of Germany's oldest and largest markets, dating to 1391, spreads across several squares in the city center.
excursions: Frankfurt on Foot & Jewish Historical Museum

days.title: Baden-Baden: spa town
days.summary: Visit this UNESCO-listed spa town, known for its hot springs since Roman times, and its Christmas market.
excursions: The Spa Town of Baden-Baden at Christmas (included)

days.title: Strasbourg: Christkindelsmärik
days.summary: Strasbourg's market in the cathedral square dates to 1570, making it the oldest in France. The included tour adds a canal cruise through Petite France.
excursions: Medieval Castle of Haut Koenigsbourg at Christmas Time

days.title: Breisach and the Black Forest
days.summary: The Weihnachtsmarkt sits in the old town near St. Stephen's Cathedral. The included tour goes to the Black Forest.

days.title: Basel: Christmas markets
days.summary: Wooden huts line the cobblestone streets of the medieval Old Town, selling carved decorations, ceramics, food and mulled wine.

days.title: Basel: departure
days.summary: Leave the ship and travel home, or continue on a post-cruise extension.

itineraries.name: Danube Holiday Markets
itineraries.route: Budapest · Bratislava · Vienna · Krems · Melk · Linz · Passau
itineraries.blurb: A Danube Christmas markets cruise on the S.S. Maria Theresa from Budapest to Passau.
itineraries.overview: This cruise on the S.S. Maria Theresa runs from Budapest to Passau through Hungary, Slovakia, Austria and Germany. Most days offer a choice of tours, with Christmas markets in Budapest, Bratislava, Vienna, Krems, Salzburg, Linz and Passau.
highlights: Vienna Art History Museum visit with Christmas markets
Full-day trip from Linz to Salzburg
Passau Christmas market in front of the cathedral

days.title: Budapest: embark
days.summary: Arrive at Budapest airport and board the ship. A transfer is provided if arranged with Uniworld.

days.title: Budapest: city tours and Christmas market
days.summary: Choose a panoramic city tour or a walk with local treats, each with a visit to the Vörösmarty Square market. A welcome reception and dinner are held in the evening.
excursions: Budapest City Tour with Christmas Market
Budapest Walk with Local Treats and Christmas Market

days.title: Danube sailing and Bratislava
days.summary: The ship cruises the Danube to Bratislava. Choose a walking tour with the Christmas market or a walk about life under Communism, with an evening return to the market also offered.
excursions: Bratislava Walking Tour with Christmas Market

days.title: Vienna: art, Christmas markets and Schönbrunn
days.summary: Options are an early visit to the Art History Museum, a food walk through the historic center, Schönbrunn Palace with its market, and a visit to a Strauss music hall.
excursions: “Morning with the Masters” at the Vienna Art History Museum & Christmas Markets

days.title: Krems and Melk
days.summary: Choose a Krems town visit with its Christkindlmarkt, a Dürnstein walk with spiced wine and an organ concert, or a walk around Melk.
excursions: Dürnstein Village Stroll with Spiced Wine Tasting and Organ Concert in a Monastery

days.title: Linz: Salzburg or cider farm
days.summary: Full-day trip to Salzburg's Old Town and Christmas market, or a Linz Old Town walk with a cider farm visit and Christmas markets.
excursions: Full-Day Salzburg Walking Tour with Christmas Market
Linz Town & Country: Cider Farm Visit and Christmas Markets

days.title: Passau: Christmas market
days.summary: Walking tour of the town with the market by the cathedral, or a winter walk on a forest path along the Ilz River.
excursions: Passau Walking Tour with Christmas Market

days.title: Passau: disembark
days.summary: Leave the ship in Passau. A transfer to Munich Airport is provided if arranged with Uniworld.

itineraries.name: Rhine Holiday Markets
itineraries.route: Basel · Strasbourg · Mannheim · Mainz · Rüdesheim · Koblenz · Cologne
itineraries.blurb: A Rhine Christmas markets cruise on the S.S. Antoinette from Basel to Cologne.
itineraries.overview: This cruise on the S.S. Antoinette runs from Basel to Cologne through Switzerland, France and Germany. Christmas market tours are offered in Basel, Strasbourg, Baden-Baden, Wiesbaden, Rüdesheim, Koblenz and Cologne.
highlights: Wish Book and Christmas market in Basel
Sailing the Upper Middle Rhine Valley to Koblenz
Day and evening market visits in Cologne

days.title: Basel: embark
days.summary: Arrive at EuroAirport Basel-Mulhouse-Freiburg and board the ship. A transfer is provided if arranged with Uniworld.

days.title: Basel: Christmas market
days.summary: Walking tour with the Town Hall, the Münster and the Christmas market. A welcome reception and dinner are held in the evening.
excursions: Basel Walking Tour with Christmas Market

days.title: Strasbourg: Christmas market
days.summary: Choose a walking tour with the Christmas market or a food walk through Petite France. An evening trip to the market is also offered.
excursions: Nights Out: The Strasbourg Christmas Market
Strasbourg Walking Tour with Christmas Market

days.title: Mannheim: Baden-Baden or vinegar estate
days.summary: Walking tour and Christmas market in Baden-Baden, or a tasting at the Doktorenhof vinegar estate.
excursions: Baden-Baden Walking Tour with Christmas Market
Private Doktorenhof Vinegar Estate Visit and Tasting

days.title: Mainz and Rüdesheim
days.summary: Time in Mainz's Old Town or a trip to the Wiesbaden Christmas market. The ship then sails to Rüdesheim for a walk with local treats or a self-guided wine tasting.
excursions: Rüdesheim Walk with Local Treats and Christmas Market
Rheinweinwelten Visit - The Best Rhine Rieslings

days.title: Upper Middle Rhine and Koblenz
days.summary: Morning sail through the UNESCO-listed Upper Middle Rhine Valley. In Koblenz, a walking tour starts at German Corner, where the Moselle meets the Rhine, and includes the Christmas market.
excursions: Koblenz Walking Tour with Christmas Market

days.title: Cologne: Old Town and Christmas markets
days.summary: Walking tour of the Old Town, ending at the cathedral square, with Christmas markets. An evening trip to the markets is also offered.
excursions: Cologne Walking Tour with Old Town Visit and Christmas Markets

days.title: Cologne: disembark
days.summary: Leave the ship in Cologne. A transfer to Cologne Bonn Airport is provided if arranged with Uniworld.

itineraries.name: Classic Christmas Markets
itineraries.route: Nuremberg · Bamberg · Kitzingen · Würzburg · Wertheim · Frankfurt
itineraries.blurb: A Christmas markets cruise within Germany, from Nuremberg to Frankfurt.
itineraries.overview: This cruise on the S.S. Elisabeth or S.S. Emilie runs from Nuremberg to Frankfurt, all within Germany. Christmas market visits are offered in Nuremberg, Bamberg, Rothenburg, Würzburg, Frankfurt and Wiesbaden, along with a village day in Franconia.
highlights: Nuremberg Christmas market by day and by night
Full-day trip to Rothenburg
Würzburg Residence visit

days.title: Nuremberg: embark
days.summary: Arrive at Nuremberg airport and board the ship. A transfer is provided if arranged with Uniworld.

days.title: Nuremberg: Christmas market
days.summary: City tour through the castle gardens and Old Town to the market on Market Square, or a World War II history tour. An evening market visit is also offered, and a welcome reception and dinner are held.
excursions: Nuremberg City Tour with Christmas Market

days.title: Bamberg: Old Town and Christmas markets
days.summary: Walking tour including the Imperial Cathedral, with free time for four Christmas markets and the nativity trail.
excursions: Bamberg Walking Tour with Christmas Market

days.title: Rothenburg and Würzburg
days.summary: Full-day trip to Rothenburg with a walking tour and Christmas market. A walk to the Würzburg Christmas market follows just before dinner.
excursions: Full-Day Rothenburg with Walking Tour and Christmas Market

days.title: Würzburg: Residence and village day
days.summary: Morning visit to the Würzburg Residence. A village day goes to Aschfeld, with a local museum and homemade Christmas food.

days.title: Wertheim: walking tour
days.summary: Mulled wine and a stollen baking demonstration on board, then a walking tour of the town, past the ruins of Wertheim Castle.
excursions: Wertheim Walking Tour with Mulled Wine and Christmas Stollen Demonstration

days.title: Frankfurt or Wiesbaden
days.summary: A food walk in Frankfurt's old town, or a trip to the Wiesbaden Christmas market.

days.title: Frankfurt: disembark
days.summary: Leave the ship in Frankfurt. A transfer to Frankfurt International Airport is provided if arranged with Uniworld.
